title: Supra-Axillary
summary: SUPRA-AX'ILLARY, adjective [supra and axil.] In botany, growing above the axil; inserted above the axil; as a peduncle. [See Suprafoliaceous.]

inlines.v: SUPRA-AX'ILLARY, adjective [supra and axil.] In botany, growing above the axil; inserted above the axil; as a peduncle. [See Suprafoliaceous.]
